release_notes: Performance/freeze rewrite: removes cross-process SetParent preview embedding, isolates iNsane in a separate preview host, adds cancellable external tools, caps Blender threads and lowers process priority, moves heavy build/preview staging to local Windows cache, replaces the growing text log with a bounded list, and moves assembly saves off the UI thread. Keeps Blender auto-creation and the permanent in-app auto-update channel.
